summary_en: Full-year dividend per share raised to 34 yen from 30 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, reflecting upward revision of net income per share to 170 yen driven by tax burden optimization following subsidiary merger and B2B subscription business growth.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Operating Results Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Oisix ra daichi Inc. announced an increase in its full-year dividend per share to 34 yen from the previously forecast 30 yen for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company revised its earnings per share guidance upward to 170 yen from 150 yen, reflecting two factors: net income attributable to parent company shareholders exceeded initial expectations by 30% year-over-year due to a structural reduction in corporate tax burden following the September 1, 2026 subsidiary merger, and the continued growth of the B2B subscription business, particularly in the food service sector. The company maintains a basic dividend policy targeting a payout ratio of 20% while securing investment funds for future growth and preserving financial soundness. The revised EPS of 170 yen represents record earnings and approaches the medium-term target of 175 yen for the fiscal year ending March 2030. The company intends to pursue further enhancement of corporate value and maximization of shareholder value through business growth centered on the B2B subscription segment and active shareholder returns.
